notes.title: The game will be released on November 5, 2025 !
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45496274/8762117e4c84158d7d8f95d1431e68d6772bf89b.png"][/img][/p][p]Faye who has practiced martial arts since childhood, finds herself transported to a fantasy world for unknown reasons. notes.title: Phoenix's Faye public test now !
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45496274/c2ddd5c0edd9e3a1287bd7a2f52e2c47f3704df9.png"][/img]The beautiful girl Faye freely practiced martial arts and somehow fell into a fantasy world. She needs to keep fighting to find her way home![/p][p]Now officially open for testing, unlocking all skills and 4 beautiful little sister character skins.[/p][p]Four featured levels are free to play:[/p][p]1) Blade and Shadow: Need to engage in fierce battles with sword soldiers, shield soldiers, and archers. Many NPCs are unable to join forces, and in the end, they must also fight against the Boss Black Wind Double Sha.[/p][p]2) Desert Zombie City: Dozens of zombies are chasing you, and to clear the level, you need to kill 250 zombies (don't ask me why it's 250).[/p][p]3) Fashion Master: The ultimate form of fighting games is women fighting, with beautiful women fighting to the point of physical strength.[/p][p]4) Mysterious Village: A Small World of Warcraft, Time Will Still Stand Still![/p][p]The intense battle and intense physical effects make you unable to stop ![/p][p]Download the demo play now ~[/p]

notes.title: Demo v2.6.x Release !
notes.content: [p]After days of continuous effort and frequent updates, the Demo has been upgraded from v2.6.0 to v2.6.9, and further optimizations are still in progress. Thank you all for playing and providing feedback. Here’s a summary of the major updates for you:[/p][olist][*][p]Added an "Early Access" level. I’ve decided to release some in-development content that has shown promising results for you all to try out early. This section will be updated irregularly, meaning you’ll get to experience the latest content periodically. Currently, the "Early Access" level features the boss battle from the "Blades and Shadows" stage—you don’t even need to complete the level to challenge this boss directly. Friendly reminder: This boss fights dirty![/p][/*][*][p]The "Blades and Shadows" level now supports progress saving. You can resume from your last checkpoint when re-entering the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the samurai sword and bow for the female protagonist, Faye, adding more attack animations and replacing some visual effects. Now you can execute more attack combos with even flashier visuals.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced NPCs in "Blades and Shadows" with more actions and hit feedback—they’ve become crazier and more fun, and they love ganging up on Faye.[/p][/*][*][p]I’ve also hidden some little surprises in the game… hope you won’t "curse" me too much when you find them![/p][/*][/olist][p]If you have any thoughts or suggestions about the game, feel free to share them in the discussion group or join our QQ group (979195753). Wishing you a thrilling and scream-worthy gaming experience![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: The game rename to: Phoenix's Faye
notes.content:
In addition to being skilled with a bow, the female protagonist is also proficient with a katana and hand-to-hand combat. As development progresses, she will unlock even more melee skills. The game's original title no longer fits, so it has been renamed: Phoenix's Faye!
Faye is a modern-day martial arts girl who, for unknown reasons, finds herself trapped in a fantasy world. She must fight her way through battles to find a way back home! Download the Demo and give it a try!

notes.title: Demo v2.0.0 Release
notes.content:
Major Updates:
1) Added a new female protagonist who can wield not only a bow but also a katana, along with expert hand-to-hand combat skills.
2) Added a new level: "Blades and Shadows."

notes.title: Demo v1.2.2 Release !
notes.content:
Updates log:
1) Added a Time Dilation toggle (for debugging purposes). When enabled, you can travel through time for a better gaming experience. This also serves as a game cheat—turn it on if you're stuck. But be warned: enabling time dilation may cause some bugs.
2) Fixed an issue where the visual effects were displayed incorrectly when firing Lightning Burst Arrows through multiple targets.
Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Demo v1.2.1 Release
notes.content:
Update log:
1) Reduced the aiming deviation caused by character movement when shooting arrows. It's now easier to aim, although there is still a slight deviation when shooting while moving.
2) Changed the full-body flaming effect of the character to preload, reducing lag when the effect appears.
Thank you all for your feedback! I will continue to improve the game!

notes.title: Demo v1.2.0 Release !
notes.content:
The game is more exciting and fun!
Update logs :
1) Added melee attack.
2) Adjusted the NPC configuration in the trial level.

notes.title: Demo v1.1.1 Release !
notes.content:
Update Log :
1) Reconstructed all content using the latest version of UE5.5.3 in preparation for the next upgrade.
2) Added more Dark Night Warriors to the trial level, making the gameplay richer and more exciting.
3) Fixed a bug where some button icons did not display when the language was set to Chinese.

notes.title: Demo v1.1.0 release！
notes.content:
[b]Latest Gameplay Features:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Four types of archery attacks for the female protagonist: Normal Arrow, Charged Electric Arrow, Rapid-Fire Arrow, Lightning Burst Arrow. 
[*] The female protagonist can perform a flying kick for melee attacks. No need to specify the attack direction; the game automatically targets the nearest enemy.
[*] Combine archery attacks, flying kicks, and dodges to unleash spectacular explosive effects.
[*] NPCs have unique traits: Some will flank you from behind. Some will self-destruct. Some deliver powerful hammer strikes. On higher difficulties, some can kill you in one hit.
[*] The mysterious village level features three random weather conditions:Clear, Thunderstorm, Snowstorm. Each creates a distinct atmospheric vibe.
[*] Game difficulty levels:Easy, Medium, Hard, Hell. Even on lower difficulties, the game feels intense, but don’t worry—players with less skill can still pull off explosive moves. On Hard and Hell difficulties, higher player skill is required, utilizing terrain and NPC traits to counterattack.
[*] The Dark Knight is fully armored with a shield and can dodge your arrows, making him a tough opponent.However, he is vulnerable to flying kicks. Kicking him from the side or behind deals significant damage, while also restoring the player’s health and boosting the fury gauge.
[*] The player’s health recovery mechanism:Instead of picking up health packs, health is restored by continuously fighting and dealing large-scale damage to enemies. Alternatively, focusing on attacking a boss’s weak points offers high risk but high reward.
[/olist]
